claim: Simulators that model interrupts per call can clear the LD A,I parity flag without an accepted interrupt; test real injected interrupts separately and keep both IFF read paths at equal fetch counts.

evidence.text: 2,114 injected IRQs, 27 of them NMOS LD A,I/R PV-clearing cases; hlib_iff's HLIB_IFF_FIXED_R makes both IFF read paths six M1s.
